source_contract.provenance: 20260924_Capacities (1).xlsx, Area need. Preliminary simplified Bornholm capacities and corrected area factors following Kenneth Karlsson’s September 30 input and Henrik’s October 8 instruction. For Skaraborg visualization, Henrik’s October 26 instruction is implemented as Low ×20, Base ×100 and High ×250 relative to the unscaled source year. Factors were calculated against current default-filter GIS potential before selection: High ×200 still fits at its model mix; ×250 demonstrates wind-area shortfall directly. Exact source observations and land-per-MW factors are retained.
source_contract.limitation: Visualization-only demonstration levels for Skaraborg, not a calibrated or validated regional forecast or observed installed capacity. Factors 20 / 100 / 250 are chosen to demonstrate area headroom and shortage, not derived from regional energy demand or generation. The years are Bornholm cp-ei source reference years; both year and illustrative scale differ across levels. Changing the mix conserves that level’s scaled MW only. Annual generation is unavailable and land demand per MW is unchanged. Actual shortfall depends on applied GIS filters and mix.
source_contract.replacement_condition: Ersätt demonstrationsvärdena med checksumskyddade och regionalt granskade kapaciteter, ytbehovsfaktorer och eventuell årsproduktion för Skaraborg genom en ny validerad kontextrevision.
